cases.name: arbitrary-som
cases.failure: SOM is declared as an arbitrary percentage of TAM/SAM without acquisition/adoption mechanics.
cases.required_behavior: Reject the derivation and require a reach/conversion/retention/revenue model or NOT_ESTIMABLE.

cases.name: fake-cac
cases.failure: An unlaunched opportunity is assigned a plausible-looking CAC without direct evidence.
cases.required_behavior: Require valid supporting evidence or mark CAC NOT_KNOWABLE_FROM_DESK_RESEARCH and name a test.

cases.name: attention-equals-demand
cases.failure: Search/social/community attention is promoted into demonstrated economic demand.
cases.required_behavior: Keep Tier E/F evidence supporting-only; economic demand cannot be demonstrated from those tiers alone.

cases.name: analyst-tam-dependence
cases.failure: A headline commercial market estimate is used as the primary TAM without bottom-up reconstruction.
cases.required_behavior: Require a bottom-up primary market construction plus at least one independent cross-check.

cases.name: category-creation-collapse
cases.failure: Current spend is treated as the ceiling on supplier revenue or economic value for a category-creating idea.
cases.required_behavior: Keep spend, revenue, and value pools separate.

cases.name: unknown-suppression
cases.failure: Load-bearing ASSUMPTION/NOT_KNOWABLE variables disappear from the executive evidence burden.
cases.required_behavior: Evidence-burden counts must reconcile exactly to the load-bearing evidence ledger.

cases.name: fatal-gate-burial
cases.failure: A fatal gate fails but the workflow continues mechanically through downstream modeling.
cases.required_behavior: Route to synthesis/stop unless an explicit evidence-changing reason justifies continued research.

cases.name: context-blindness
cases.failure: Napkin-stage and growth-stage opportunities use the same evidence profile.
cases.required_behavior: Decision context must control the evidence emphasis and primary question.

cases.name: cagr-ambiguity
cases.failure: CAGR is reported without real/nominal, currency, years, geography, or market definition metadata.
cases.required_behavior: Reject incomplete CAGR metadata; real series also require a base year.

cases.name: confirmation-only-search
cases.failure: Falsification is marked complete without any genuinely inverted query.
cases.required_behavior: Require at least one recorded query designed to find evidence against the thesis.
